sweep.title: Fund sweep
sweep.sub: Deposit addresses → cold wallet. Ethereum, BSC: contract forwarders swept by the server; TRON: offline signing
sweep.notLiveDesc: The fund sweep pages are switched off.
sweep.contractHint: The server signs one batch transaction with the operator account. Each address can only send USDT to the cold wallet (Safe multisig) fixed in the contract; first-time addresses deploy their forwarder in the same transaction. A stolen operator key cannot move the funds.
sweep.offlineHint: TRON uses plain addresses: when preparing, the hot wallet sends 1 TRX to each unactivated address; download the unsigned file on the batch page, sign it offline and import it. On Broadcast the system first rents energy for each address and broadcasts once it arrives, falling back to a TRX top-up if renting fails. The list is valid for 20 hours (TRON transactions expire within 24 hours).
sweep.emptyCandidates: No address is above the threshold
sweep.runDesc: {{chain}}: one batch transaction sweeps {{count}} addresses, about {{usdt}} USDT, all to the cold wallet below.
sweep.prepareDesc: {{chain}}: {{count}} addresses, about {{usdt}} USDT. The hot wallet sends 1 TRX to each unactivated address; after signing and importing, Broadcast rents energy first. Sign and broadcast before the list expires.
sweep.notSignable: Only batches awaiting signature or imported can do this
sweep.broadcastDesc: Broadcast {{count}} verified transactions (rejected ones are not sent).
sweep.cancelDesc: Everything not broadcast is cancelled and will be swept next time; no rent is paid for items not yet rented, and activation TRX stays at the address.
sweep.retryDesc: Failed and deferred addresses go into a new batch.
sweep.noRetry: Only partial, failed or deferred batches can be retried
sweep.expiresHint: This list expires at {{time}}; after that the signatures are void and a new list is needed.
sweep.evmTitle: Contracts and cold wallet (read from chain)
sweep.evmParentHint: The cold wallet (parent) is fixed in every forwarder and in the address formula; the admin cannot change it. To rotate signers, do it in the Safe; the address stays the same.
sweep.targetChangeDesc: Takes effect {{hours}} hours after submission and can be cancelled meanwhile; alert emails are sent on submit and on effect. The offline signer also checks your own saved cold address.
sweep.addressRequired: Enter the new cold wallet address
sweep.addressFormat: A TRON address starts with T and has 34 characters
sweep.cancelChangeTitle: Cancel the pending cold wallet change
sweep.tronTargetHint: Must not be one of our deposit addresses, the hot wallet or the USDT contract.
sweep.autoHint: Off by default: run manually for a month first; deferred while Ethereum gas is above the cap
sweep.tronExpireHint: 1–23 hours; TRON transactions expire within 24 hours on chain
sweep.saveDesc: Saving creates version {{v}}; before/after values go to the audit log.
sweep.tronTopupHint: Used to activate new addresses (1 TRX each) and for the burn fallback
sweep.paramsHint: Thresholds and the fee ratio cap are editable here (Amos 10-20 review). Saving is high-risk, needs a reason and is audited. Defaults are shown under each field.
sweep.maxFeeRatioHint: Addresses whose estimated fee in USD exceeds amount × this ratio are skipped
sweep.evmCapsHint: Mitigation for skipping a third-party audit (SW-4): larger addresses are skipped and swept manually from the Safe; raise gradually, 0 = no cap
sweep.energyHint: Provider: {{provider}} (server config). Energy is rented for each deposit address before broadcasting
sweep.fallbackBurn: Fall back to burning TRX if renting fails
sweep.rentBalanceMinHint: 0 = off; Amos tops up the provider balance, keep it under 1,000 TRX
sweep.rentQuote: Energy rental: {{provider}} quotes {{price}} sun / energy, {{energy}} energy for {{min}} minutes per address (burning is {{burn}} sun / energy)
sweep.rentFlowHint: Energy is ordered only after import, on Broadcast: rent → confirm delivery → broadcast the signed transaction → reclaimed at expiry. Undelivered items fall back to a hot-wallet TRX top-up if enabled.
sweep.burnModeHint: Burn mode: the hot wallet tops up TRX for each address; energy is burned at 100 sun.
sweep.rentBeforeBroadcast: On Broadcast the system rents energy for each verified address and broadcasts once it arrives; items not delivered within 2 minutes fall back to a hot-wallet TRX top-up if enabled.
sweep.nextPhaseTron: TRON sweeping (offline signing + energy rental) is the next phase and is not available yet. TRON deposits are credited as usual.
sweep.nextPhaseSettings: TRON cold wallet, energy rental, auto-sweep, Ethereum gas cap and reminders are the next phase and are hidden for now.

rs.screensHint: PNG / JPG, up to 2 MB each, at most 5 (not public)
rs.noteHint: Public on the market page, 1–1,000 characters
rs.directNote: Confirm "{{opt}}" directly: the review period and dispute window start
rs.voidProposal: This proposal voids the market: confirming refunds every bet
rs.onHold: On hold; voided by the system if not released by {{t}}

pm.title: Parameters
pm.sub: Category fees, bet limits, dispute windows, KYC threshold, minimum withdrawal, risk alert thresholds
pm.hint: Changes are high-risk: a reason is required and before → after is audited. Default fees only apply to markets created afterwards.

key.kyc_depositThreshold: ID + selfie required above total deposits of
key.risk_lateBet_minutes: Large late bet: within minutes before close
key.risk_lateBet_poolPct: Large late bet: share of the pool after the bet
key.risk_longshot_accountDays: Long shot: account age counted as new
key.risk_longshot_minAmount: Long shot: single bet at least
key.risk_link_maxUsersPerKey: Linked accounts: max customers per device / IP / address

pm.minWithdrawHint: Must exceed every chain’s withdrawal fee (ERC20 5, TRC20 1, BEP20 0.5 USDT)
pm.withdrawNote: Withdrawal fees are in System config (config:edit); the minimum must exceed every chain’s fee.
pm.feeNote: Charged on winners’ profit only; per-market fees are edited in Markets.
pm.resolveNote: Overdue items are flagged on the resolution desk and emailed to the responsible roles
pm.sportsNote: Used when generating drafts from fixtures: close N minutes before kick-off; event end = kick-off + N minutes
pm.riskNote: Odds are after the fee (as customers see them); a value shared by more customers than the limit (public networks, exchange addresses) no longer links them.

dash.sub: Today / last 7 days in UTC; open an item to handle it

mkd.cancelNote: All bets are fully refunded; this cannot be undone
mkd.advanceNote: Can only be moved earlier; bets received after the new close are refunded at settlement
mkd.feeNote: 0%–20%, up to 2 decimals; changes after listing notify bettors of this market (#22)
mkd.clarifyNote: Clarifications explain the rules only; they cannot change the question, options or close time. Bettors get inbox notice #18
mkd.voidNote: All bets are fully refunded; once settlement has started you can only compensate
mkd.compNote: Top-ups only: recompute each customer's entitlement with the correct result; the platform pays any shortfall. Once per market
mkd.compNothing: Nobody needs compensation for this result

voidWhy.NOT_ENOUGH_OPTIONS: Fewer than two options had bets at close
voidWhy.NO_POOL: Pool empty after refunding late bets
voidWhy.ABANDONED_48H: Abandoned; no official result within 48 hours

ag.title: Crypto auto-generation
ag.sub: Generates crypto up/down markets by schedule (fixed slots) or rolling windows and lists them directly; someone with listing permission checks before enabling
ag.slotsHint: 1-hour slots must be on the hour; 15-minute slots on a quarter hour. Beijing time: {{bj}}
ag.aheadHint: Minutes before betting opens (default 1440 = one day ahead, AC-80)
ag.enableNote: Once enabled, markets are generated and listed directly (no listing review). Check the rendered title, rules, sources and options below first
ag.checked: I have checked the rendered market against section 4.1
ag.disableNote: No new markets will be generated; existing ones close and resolve as usual
ag.missing: The rendered market is missing required fields
ag.tplSaveNote: Auto-generations using it must be checked again before enabling
ag.tplInUse: An enabled auto-generation uses this template; disable it first

sp.title: Sports fixtures
sp.sub: Fixtures are synced from the data source (next 7 days); confirm that both sources list the same match, then generate drafts
sp.empty: No fixtures: click "Sync now" to fetch
sp.mapHint: The system only suggests candidates; a person must confirm it is the same match (X-12). Without a mapping only one source is available and resolution goes manual
sp.noCandidates: No candidates; search again or enter a backup source ID
sp.genNoMapping: No mapping yet: drafts can be generated, but resolution will go manual with only one source
sp.genDone: {{n}} drafts generated; submit them for listing as usual

warn.mappingNotConfirmed: The backup source's match is not confirmed yet: resolution will go manual with only one source

ds.title: Review & disputes
ds.sub: Markets under review and disputes; uphold / overturn / void — one person with permission is enough, settlement follows immediately
ds.pick: Pick a market to see and handle its disputes
ds.note: Conclusion and reasons (public; disputers are not shown)
ds.fillFirst: Write the conclusion; choose a new result to overturn
ds.afterNote: Settlement follows immediately (no second review). Disputers get #15; on overturn all bettors get #16

sr.title: Settlement runs
sr.sub: Payout and refund runs; abnormal settlements move no money and are retried after the pool reconciliation issues are handled
sr.retryNote: Confirm the pool reconciliation issues are handled (it is checked again before settling)

pr.title: Pool reconciliation
pr.sub: Pools, bets and the ledger are checked daily at 00:30 UTC; markets with differences pause payouts until handled

cp.title: Compensation
cp.sub: When a settled market turns out to be wrong, the platform tops up customers based on the correct result; top-ups only, once per market
cp.summary: {{total}} USDT to {{n}} customers at the original fee of {{rate}}%

rp.title: Reports
rp.sub: Platform revenue = fees + settlement dust; compensation is shown separately and not netted; by UTC date
rp.note: Daily figures use the completion time of settlement runs (UTC); voided and cancelled markets are not charged.

ra.title: Risk alerts
ra.sub: Large late bets, linked accounts on opposite options, new accounts winning long shots, withdrawals without betting; new alerts are emailed — mark the outcome after review

kind.new_account_longshot: New account won a long shot

ra.noteLabel: Note (required, recorded in the audit log)

notePh.handled: e.g. Contacted the customer and restricted withdrawals
notePh.false_positive: e.g. Two accounts of the same household, verified
